_readme: DTI ledger records (DLIs) from DTIF's free monthly snapshot, mapped to CAIP-2 where public evidence supports it. The snapshot redacts AnchorBlockHash, so every CAIP-2 here rests on independently checkable sources (ethereum-lists, chain documentation, public genesis data) cited in `evidence`. Entries with caip2 null are either permissioned ledgers with no public chain identifier, or chains we have not yet matched to a public source.
